coverTag: A concept for a new five-star landmark north of the IJ: old Amsterdam, seen from the new, in a collection that makes every arrival an encounter.
headline: A new five-star landmark north of the IJ deserves art that is an encounter in itself.
opportunity: The Encounter brings five-star hospitality to Amsterdam-Noord at a generous scale: 197 rooms and a rooftop with a restaurant, cocktail bar and pool, looking back across the water at the historic city. That view, old Amsterdam seen from the new, suggests a collection built on contrast: the light and heritage of the Golden Age, translated into a contemporary visual language that belongs in Noord.

reading.title: The view is the story

reading.title: The rooftop is a stage

concept.title: North Light
concept.subtitle: Old Amsterdam, seen from the new
concept.statement: North Light treats the hotel as a vantage point. Public spaces carry large signature works that look back at the historic city through Gallery Dutch Art's palette of cobalt, ivory and gold. The rooms hold a numbered series that turns the skyline into intimate studies. On the rooftop, a Living Painting follows the colour of the Amsterdam sky from golden hour into night.

collection.text: Light breaking into spectrum over Dutch silhouettes: a contemporary statement for the entrance.
The canal skyline at golden hour, proposed as a slow-moving digital work for the rooftop bar.
The basis for the room collection: mirrored façades, re-composed for each floor.
Luminous tulips on deep night: evocative, warm and made for the evening.

email.subject: North Light: an art concept for The Encounter
body: Congratulations on bringing a new five-star hotel to Amsterdam-Noord.

I'm Mariska Beenen of Gallery Dutch Art, an Amsterdam studio creating bespoke art and collections for hospitality. Inspired by the plans for The Encounter, we prepared a short concept, "North Light": a signature arrival work, a numbered series across the rooms and a Living Painting for the rooftop that follows the Amsterdam sky from golden hour into night, all built on the view of old Amsterdam seen from the new.
Would you be open to a twenty-minute conversation in the coming weeks?

Warm regards,
Mariska Beenen
Gallery Dutch Art · Amsterdam
gallerydutchart@gmail.com · www.gallerydutchart.nl
